messages:
Nora Lee: Quick idea 1: run a microexperiment on the pricing page focusing on the calculator placement + tier naming. Goal: increase "get-a-quote" clicks and reduce confusion on packages. Thinking: compact calculator on desktop hero vs modal triggered by CTA. Also test renaming tiers (Core -> Developer, Pro -> Team, Scale -> Business).

Diego Ramos: Sounds good. Can we add a locked demo flow for high-intent outputs? If calculator predicts >$4k/month, prompt a demo booking modal and route to AE. Otherwise show self-serve CTA.

Priya Shah: Agree. Need to define the estimator assumptions clearly (tokens/month, avg seq length, concurrency). I'll draft the estimator tooltip and include a small benchmark line: "typical 1k seq, 3B model = $X/token" so customers understand cost drivers.

Tom Nguyen: Design note: modal is more interruptive but higher intent. Suggest we A/B test modal vs inline reveal. Also propose a microcopy test for CTA text: "Estimate my cost" vs "Get tailored pricing" vs "See plan recommendation".

Nora Lee: Routing rules: AE for predicted ARR >= 48000/year (so monthly ~= 4k) OR if company_size >= 100 and checkbox "I need SLA" checked. Fallback to SDR. Also exclude EU-only for AE until compliance sign-off.

sales-ops-bot: Test endpoint available at https://hooks.internal.redwood/pricing-routing with header X-RW-Env: staging. Sample payload accepted.

Diego Ramos: Event tracking names: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_calc_recommendation_shown, pricing_lead_routed. Priya can you add UTM mapping?

Priya Shah: I'll add UTM and amplitude props: utm_source, utm_campaign, calc_variant, tier_choice. Also add property "estimated_annual" on the submitted event so we can threshold in analytics.

Tom Nguyen: Small accessibility note: ensure the calculator fields are keyboard focusable and aria-live updates when recommendation changes. Design will provide specs by EOD. :accessibility: 

Nora Lee: Draft rollout plan: 1) wire telemetry + routing in staging (2 days), 2) copy + design QA (2 days), 3) GA experiment live for 7 days, 4) review results and pick winner. Metrics: CTA CVR, calc_submit -> demo conversion, routed_leads count, and time-on-page.

Priya Shah: Copy variants for the tier names in the calc recommendation: Variant 1: Developer / Team / Business. Variant 2: Starter / Growth / Enterprise. Variant 3: Usage Basic / Usage Plus / Usage Premium. We'll rotate evenly. Tag exposures with "tier_name_variant".

Diego Ramos: For the benchmark narrative, I'll prepare a short comparison box: "Avg cost per 1k tokens vs comparable managed options" with our numbers and a note linking to the performance appendix. Lina is out but will confirm perf numbers next week.

Tom Nguyen: I'll mock both placements and upload to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/pricing-calc-experiments. Please comment on the frames you prefer.

Nora Lee: Quick test routing snippet to simulate decision logic (sales ops can mirror in rules engine):

```json
{"decision": "route_to", "predicted_annual": 60000, "company_size": 120, "sla_required": true, "result": "AE_queue"}
```

sales-ops-bot: Routing rule created in staging. Rule ID: rr_2026_pricing_exp. Use header X-RW-Test: true for simulation.

Priya Shah: I'll update the experiment doc and push drafts for calculator microcopy. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/marketing/pricing-estimator-experiment. Requesting review from Sales Ops and Legal for routing exceptions.

Diego Ramos: Also suggesting a short webinar "How we price inference" as a follow-up to explain assumptions and the new estimator. Could be product-led with a short live demo. Nora, want to co-host?

Nora Lee: Yes, happy to co-host. Let's tentatively schedule a webinar 2 weeks after experiment end and include an exclusive early invite for participants who used the calculator and had predicted >$4k/mo.

Tom Nguyen: FYI I'll include a subtle badge "Recommended for you" on the suggested tier so users focus on conversion. A/B will verify impact.

Nora Lee: Action items: Priya 1 telemetry + doc updates; Diego 1 benchmark box + webinar plan; Tom 1 designs + figma frames; Sales Ops 1 confirm routing & webhook tests; Legal 1 check EU routing constraint. We'll sync in 4 days. :calendar:
